messages.subject: For Kelly Ortberg | Aerospace, government relations and stakeholder execution
messages.body:
Dear Boeing Investor Relations Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Kelly Ortberg, President and Chief Executive Officer.

Boeing's global aerospace business operates across highly regulated environments where governments, aviation authorities, safety priorities, communities and supply-chain partners must remain closely aligned. That interface closely matches my experience.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities span government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory, including coordination with aviation and other public authorities.

I would welcome a senior conversation about where this combination of government relations, aviation coordination and stakeholder execution might support Boeing's priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Boeing.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
